blurb: Guests can take helicopter tours over iconic landmarks and coastlines in Maine and New Hampshire, including customized tours. Flight training is offered from introductory flights to commercial pilot and instructor certifications. Charters and air taxi services are available throughout the Northeast. Event space rental is offered in their hangar with helicopter backdrops.
